user_query: I want to stay updated on the latest news in the entertainment industry. Can you provide me with trending articles in English? Please retrieve ten articles at a time and exclude sources like variety.com and deadline.com.

TaskList.description: Fetch the latest trending articles in the entertainment industry in English.
Filter the retrieved articles to exclude those from variety.com and deadline.com.
Limit the final list to ten articles and return them to the user.
